verdict.rationale: Docs confirm NFC-capable USB-A/NFC and USB-C/NFC form factors compatible with Android and iOS 13.3+ for signing into Google Account 2SV/passkeys via mobile browsers and apps, directly matching the story. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of NFC tap-to-authenticate specifically in third-party (non-Google) mobile apps/browsers, and any reported friction/reliability issues with NFC tapping.
